answer: Prayers & Duties >> Qurbani (Slaughtering) Question ID: 3554 Country: India Title: Can we take ahle-quran as a partner in Qurbani? Plz give some daleel? Question: Assalamualaikum. Can we take ahle-quran as a partner in Qurbani? Plz give some daleel? Answer ID: 3554 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 421/376=D) The sect which is called 'Ahl-e-Quran? denies the hadith, its followers make fun of the traditions of the Prophet ( صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ), they reject the five obligatory prayers; therefore this sect is out of Islamic fold due to its heinous beliefs. The person about whom you are questioning, if he himself claims to be an Ahl-e-Quran or he holds the above beliefs then he is out of Islam, it is unlawful to take him as partner in ones qurbani. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
